// Output type: CMOT Float 3 (linear emissive colour; plug into Emissive Color of an Unlit material).
// Inputs (add these pins with exactly these names):
//   per pixel : N (float3), L (float3), V (float3), KeyColor (float3), ShadowedNL (float1), BaseColor (float3), ShadeTexture (float3), Occlusion (float1), ReceiveShadowMask (float1), MatCapAdd (float3), MatCapMul (float3), MatCapAddMask (float1)
//   material  : ShadeTint1 (float3), ShadeShift1 (float1), ShadeSoft1 (float1), ShadeTint2 (float3), ShadeShift2 (float1), ShadeSoft2 (float1), UseShadeTexture (float1), ReceiveShadow (float1), NormalOverride (float3), NormalOverrideMix (float1), LitTint (float3), RimColor (float3), RimStrength (float1), RimWidth (float1), RimSoft (float1), RimLitBias (float1), SpecColor (float3), SpecStrength (float1), SpecSize (float1), SpecSoft (float1), MatCapAddStrength (float1), MatCapMulStrength (float1), Unlit (float1), HighlightKnee (float1), OcclusionShift (float1), OcclusionDarken (float1), TerminatorColor (float3), TerminatorStrength (float1), TerminatorWidth (float1), BaseLift (float1), BaseLiftColor (float3), BaseSaturation (float1)
// Directions N, L, V in the same world space. MatCapAdd / MatCapMul are sampled outside with
// the UV from AngelToonMatCapUV_UE (view-space normal, V = 0 at the top row).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Per-material constants (one set per material; see the table "inputs")
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct AngelToonMaterial
{
    float3 ShadeTint1;          // 1st shade tint (multiplies the base colour)
    float  ShadeShift1;         // 1st shade border position on N.L (bigger = wider shade)
    float  ShadeSoft1;          // half width of the 1st soft step
    float3 ShadeTint2;          // 2nd shade tint (multiplies the 1st shade)
    float  ShadeShift2;
    float  ShadeSoft2;
    float  UseShadeTexture;     // 1 = shade colour from ShadeTexture, 0 = from the base colour
    float  ReceiveShadow;       // cast-shadow strength (0 = ignore cast shadows)
    float3 NormalOverride;      // optional normal override (unused when NormalOverrideMix = 0)
    float  NormalOverrideMix;
    float3 LitTint;             // tint of the lit side
    float3 RimColor;            // rim light
    float  RimStrength;
    float  RimWidth;
    float  RimSoft;
    float  RimLitBias;          // 0 = rim all around, 1 = rim only on the lit side
    float3 SpecColor;           // soft specular
    float  SpecStrength;
    float  SpecSize;            // N.H threshold (closer to 1 = smaller)
    float  SpecSoft;
    float  MatCapAddStrength;   // additive MatCap
    float  MatCapMulStrength;   // multiplicative MatCap (0.5 in the texture = no change)
    float  Unlit;               // share of the plain base colour, independent of light
    float  HighlightKnee;       // brightest channel above this rolls off softly toward 1.0 (1 = off)
    float  OcclusionShift;      // how far baked occlusion pushes N.L down
    float  OcclusionDarken;     // extra 2nd-shade tint in occluded areas
    float3 TerminatorColor;     // thin band at the light/shade border (multiply)
    float  TerminatorStrength;
    float  TerminatorWidth;
    float  BaseLift;            // pull the base colour toward BaseLiftColor
    float3 BaseLiftColor;
    float  BaseSaturation;      // 1 = unchanged
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Per-pixel inputs (prepared by the engine)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct AngelToonInput
{
    float3 N;                   // shading normal (world). Flip it toward the viewer on back faces.
    float3 L;                   // direction TO the key (main) light (world)
    float3 V;                   // direction TO the camera (world; orthographic = camera back axis)
    float3 KeyColor;            // key light colour, white of intensity 1 = (1,1,1)
    float  ShadowedNL;          // N.L with cast shadows applied: AngelToonShadowedNL(N.L, shadow)
    float3 BaseColor;           // linear base colour
    float3 ShadeTexture;        // linear shade texture colour (used only when UseShadeTexture = 1)
    float  Occlusion;           // baked occlusion, 1 = open, 0 = deep (mask R)
    float  ReceiveShadowMask;   // where cast shadows are received (mask A or 1)
    float3 MatCapAdd;           // additive MatCap sample (linear), or the material constant
    float3 MatCapMul;           // multiplicative MatCap sample (linear), or the material constant
    float  MatCapAddMask;       // where the additive MatCap applies (mask A or 1)
};
struct AngelToonFns
{
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Small parts that behave like the Blender nodes
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    float AngelToonClamp01(float x)
    {
        return clamp(x, 0.0, 1.0);
    }

    // Blender Map Range (FLOAT, SMOOTHSTEP, clamp). Returns 0 when lo == hi.
    float AngelToonSmoothstep(float lo, float hi, float x)
    {
        float d = hi - lo;
        float t = (d != 0.0) ? (x - lo) / d : 0.0;
        t = clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
        return (3.0 - 2.0 * t) * (t * t);
    }

    // Blender Mix (RGBA, MIX) with the factor clamped to 0..1
    float3 AngelToonMix3(float3 a, float3 b, float f)
    {
        float t = clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0);
        return a * (1.0 - t) + b * t;
    }

    float AngelToonMix1(float a, float b, float f)
    {
        float t = clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0);
        return a * (1.0 - t) + b * t;
    }

    // Blender Vector Math NORMALIZE: a zero vector stays zero
    float3 AngelToonSafeNormalize(float3 v)
    {
        float l2 = dot(v, v);
        return (l2 > 0.0) ? v * rsqrt(l2) : float3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    }

    // Blender RGB to BW: luminance of linear Rec.709 (checked against Blender 5.2)
    float AngelToonLuminance(float3 c)
    {
        return dot(c, float3(0.2126729, 0.7151522, 0.0721750));
    }

    // N.L with the engine's main-light shadow (shadowAtten: 1 = lit, 0 = in shadow).
    // gain: 1.25 reproduces the Blender reference (its shadow probe returns 1.25 x N.L when unshadowed,
    // so a partly shadowed point only darkens once shadowAtten < 0.8). Use 1.0 for a plain N.L x shadow.
    float AngelToonShadowedNL(float NL, float shadowAtten, float gain)
    {
        return clamp(NL, 0.0, 1.0) * shadowAtten * gain;
    }

    // MatCap UV from a right-handed camera-space normal:
    //   +X = screen right, +Y = screen up, +Z = toward the viewer (Blender / OpenGL / Unity view space).
    //   UV origin at the bottom-left of the image (V up), as in Blender and Unity.
    float2 AngelToonMatCapUV(float3 normalVS)
    {
        float3 n = AngelToonSafeNormalize(normalVS);
        return n.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
    }

    // Unreal: view space is left-handed (+Z = away from the viewer) and texture V = 0 is the TOP row.
    float2 AngelToonMatCapUV_UE(float3 normalViewUE)
    {
        float3 n = AngelToonSafeNormalize(normalViewUE);
        return float2(n.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - n.y * 0.5);
    }

    // Soft highlight roll-off: the brightest channel m above k is mapped with 1 - exp(-x),
    // all channels are scaled by the same factor (keeps RGB ratios).
    float3 AngelToonHighlightKnee(float3 c, float k)
    {
        float m = max(max(c.r, c.g), c.b);                       // [S22]
        float over = max(m - k, 0.0);
        float rng = max(1.0 - k, 0.001);
        float y = min(m, k) + rng * (1.0 - exp(-(over / rng)));  // [S23]
        return c * (y / max(m, 0.0001));                         // [S24]
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Main shading: colour of one pixel (linear)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    float3 AngelToonShade(AngelToonInput i, AngelToonMaterial m)
    {
        // directions                                                             [S01]
        float3 N = AngelToonSafeNormalize(AngelToonMix3(i.N, m.NormalOverride, m.NormalOverrideMix));
        float3 L = AngelToonSafeNormalize(i.L);
        float3 V = AngelToonSafeNormalize(i.V);
        float NL = dot(N, L);
        // cast shadow: lower N.L only inside shadows, mixed by the receive strength [S02]
        float NLs = min(NL, i.ShadowedNL);
        float Ls0 = AngelToonMix1(NL, NLs, m.ReceiveShadow * i.ReceiveShadowMask);
        // baked occlusion pushes N.L down in crevices                            [S03]
        float occ = AngelToonSmoothstep(0.05, 0.9, 1.0 - i.Occlusion);
        float Ls = Ls0 - occ * m.OcclusionShift;
        // two soft steps                                                         [S04]
        float t1 = AngelToonSmoothstep(m.ShadeShift1 - m.ShadeSoft1, m.ShadeShift1 + m.ShadeSoft1, Ls);
        float t2 = AngelToonSmoothstep(m.ShadeShift2 - m.ShadeSoft2, m.ShadeShift2 + m.ShadeSoft2, Ls);
        // base colour: lift, then saturation                                     [S05]
        float3 base = AngelToonMix3(i.BaseColor, m.BaseLiftColor, m.BaseLift);
        float gray = AngelToonLuminance(base);
        base = AngelToonMix3(float3(gray, gray, gray), base, m.BaseSaturation);
        // shade colours and lit colour                                           [S06]
        float3 shadeSrc = AngelToonMix3(base, i.ShadeTexture, m.UseShadeTexture);
        float3 shade1 = shadeSrc * m.ShadeTint1;
        float3 shade2 = shade1 * m.ShadeTint2;
        float3 lit = (base * m.LitTint) * i.KeyColor;
        // shade 2 -> shade 1 -> lit                                              [S07]
        float3 c = AngelToonMix3(shade2, shade1, t2);
        c = AngelToonMix3(c, lit, t1);
        // terminator band                                                        [S08]
        float s1 = m.ShadeShift1;
        float band = AngelToonSmoothstep(s1 - m.TerminatorWidth, s1, Ls)
                   * (1.0 - AngelToonSmoothstep(s1, s1 + m.TerminatorWidth, Ls));
        c = AngelToonMix3(c, c * m.TerminatorColor, band * m.TerminatorStrength);
        // 2nd shade tint in crevices                                             [S09]
        c = AngelToonMix3(c, c * m.ShadeTint2, occ * m.OcclusionDarken);
        float openK = 1.0 - occ;                                               // [S10]
        // rim                                                                    [S11]
        float nv = max(dot(N, V), 0.0);
        float fres = 1.0 - nv;
        float rim = AngelToonSmoothstep((1.0 - m.RimWidth) - m.RimSoft, (1.0 - m.RimWidth) + m.RimSoft, fres);
        float rbias = AngelToonMix1(1.0, t1, m.RimLitBias);
        float rimK = ((rim * rbias) * m.RimStrength) * openK;
        c = c + m.RimColor * AngelToonClamp01(rimK);                            // [S12]
        // soft specular on the lit side                                          [S13]
        float3 H = AngelToonSafeNormalize(L + V);
        float nh = max(dot(N, H), 0.0);
        float sp = AngelToonSmoothstep(m.SpecSize - m.SpecSoft, m.SpecSize + m.SpecSoft, nh);
        float spK = ((sp * t1) * m.SpecStrength) * openK;
        c = c + m.SpecColor * AngelToonClamp01(spK);                            // [S14]
        // MatCap: multiply (0.5 = no change), then add                           [S15]
        float3 mcm = c * (i.MatCapMul * 2.0);
        c = AngelToonMix3(c, mcm, m.MatCapMulStrength);
        float mcaK = (m.MatCapAddStrength * i.MatCapAddMask) * openK;           // [S16]
        c = c + i.MatCapAdd * AngelToonClamp01(mcaK);
        // unlit share                                                            [S17]
        c = AngelToonMix3(c, base, m.Unlit);
        // soft highlight roll-off                                                [S18]
        return AngelToonHighlightKnee(c, m.HighlightKnee);
    }

    // Two-layer materials (one texture holding two kinds of surface, e.g. skin and cloth):
    // shade both parameter sets and blend the finished colours by a mask (mask G).  [S19]
    float3 AngelToonShadeTwoLayer(AngelToonInput iA, AngelToonMaterial mA,
                                                 AngelToonInput iB, AngelToonMaterial mB, float maskB)
    {
        float3 ca = AngelToonShade(iA, mA);
        float3 cb = AngelToonShade(iB, mB);
        return AngelToonMix3(ca, cb, maskB);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Outline (inverted hull)                                                    [S20]
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Line colour = base colour x outline tint (unlit, no shading, no roll-off).
    // For two-layer materials blend the tints by the same mask before multiplying.
    float3 AngelToonOutlineColor(float3 baseColor, float3 outlineTint)
    {
        return baseColor * outlineTint;
    }

    // Draw the line only where the outline mask (mask B) is above 0.5.
    float AngelToonOutlineVisible(float outlineMask)
    {
        return (outlineMask > 0.5) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    }

    // World size of one pixel at a vertex.
    //   clipW: clip-space w (1 for orthographic), projM11: projection matrix [1][1]
    //   (perspective 1/tan(vfov/2), orthographic 2/view height), screenHeightPx: target height in pixels.
    float AngelToonPixelWorldSize(float clipW, float projM11, float screenHeightPx)
    {
        return 2.0 * clipW / (projM11 * screenHeightPx);
    }

    // Spec v1 outline width in pixels: gain x (natural world width in pixels), clamped to [minPx, maxPx].
    // gain = 1, minPx = 0, maxPx = huge gives the plain world width of the Blender reference.
    float AngelToonOutlinePixels(float widthWorld, float pixelWorld, float gain, float minPx, float maxPx)
    {
        float px = gain * widthWorld / max(pixelWorld, 1e-8);
        return clamp(px, minPx, maxPx);
    }

    // Push a clip-space position by px pixels along the screen-projected normal.
    //   normalCSxy: xy of (projection x view-space normal). screenSizePx: (width, height) in pixels.
    float4 AngelToonOutlinePushClip(float4 posCS, float2 normalCSxy, float px, float2 screenSizePx)
    {
        float2 dirPx = normalCSxy * screenSizePx;   // to pixel units (removes the aspect ratio)
        float l = length(dirPx);
        float2 d = (l > 0.0) ? dirPx / l : float2(0.0, 0.0);
        posCS.xy += d * (2.0 * px / screenSizePx) * posCS.w;
        return posCS;
    }
};
AngelToonFns F;
AngelToonMaterial m;
m.ShadeTint1 = ShadeTint1;
m.ShadeShift1 = ShadeShift1;
m.ShadeSoft1 = ShadeSoft1;
m.ShadeTint2 = ShadeTint2;
m.ShadeShift2 = ShadeShift2;
m.ShadeSoft2 = ShadeSoft2;
m.UseShadeTexture = UseShadeTexture;
m.ReceiveShadow = ReceiveShadow;
m.NormalOverride = NormalOverride;
m.NormalOverrideMix = NormalOverrideMix;
m.LitTint = LitTint;
m.RimColor = RimColor;
m.RimStrength = RimStrength;
m.RimWidth = RimWidth;
m.RimSoft = RimSoft;
m.RimLitBias = RimLitBias;
m.SpecColor = SpecColor;
m.SpecStrength = SpecStrength;
m.SpecSize = SpecSize;
m.SpecSoft = SpecSoft;
m.MatCapAddStrength = MatCapAddStrength;
m.MatCapMulStrength = MatCapMulStrength;
m.Unlit = Unlit;
m.HighlightKnee = HighlightKnee;
m.OcclusionShift = OcclusionShift;
m.OcclusionDarken = OcclusionDarken;
m.TerminatorColor = TerminatorColor;
m.TerminatorStrength = TerminatorStrength;
m.TerminatorWidth = TerminatorWidth;
m.BaseLift = BaseLift;
m.BaseLiftColor = BaseLiftColor;
m.BaseSaturation = BaseSaturation;
AngelToonInput i;
i.N = N;
i.L = L;
i.V = V;
i.KeyColor = KeyColor;
i.ShadowedNL = ShadowedNL;
i.BaseColor = BaseColor;
i.ShadeTexture = ShadeTexture;
i.Occlusion = Occlusion;
i.ReceiveShadowMask = ReceiveShadowMask;
i.MatCapAdd = MatCapAdd;
i.MatCapMul = MatCapMul;
i.MatCapAddMask = MatCapAddMask;
return F.AngelToonShade(i, m);
